text:
maria: SSO (Okta) is flaking; several folks can't complete prod deploys. Can we grant temporary deployer delegation to @anita for a hotfix? Need it for ~1h. cc @ted

josh: Is this MFA failure or SSO auth error? any logs?

maria: MFA is fine locally, our SSO auth is returning 502 during token exchange. Error from idp: "upstream connect error". Happening across us-east-1 only.

anita: I can run the hotfix if given short-lived perms. I already have developer role but not prod-deploy. Happy to follow rollback checklist.

maria: ran the JIT request:
```
/request-jit --env prod --assignee anita --duration 60m --reason "Okta outage - urgent hotfix" --ticket INC-12345
```

deploy-bot: JIT request received: ticket=INC-12345, assignee=anita, duration=60m. Awaiting approver with deploy.elevate role.

ted: I approve. Granting breakglass for 60m. Logging approval. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall-bot: approval recorded by ted at 2026-03-20T15:26:10Z. Audit ID audit-20260320-9876

josh: Before you run anything, pin the release to the hotfix tag and do canary at 10% for 15m. If error rate >5% or latency >2x baseline, abort and roll back.

anita: plan: canary deploy v1.3.2-hotfix -> sha abcdef12345 to canary subset. If green, roll to 100% over 10m. Starting now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: image=redwood/api:1.3.2-hotfix@sha256:abcdef12345; strategy=canary(10%/15m)

deploy-bot: canary health: 0 errors in 300 requests, avg latency 120ms

maria: monitoring... :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary complete, metrics within thresholds. Promoting to 100% over 10m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. All pods healthy.

josh: Nice. Quick notes: (1) rotate the temporary role binding immediately, (2) add reason/ticket to audit log, (3) follow up with infra-sec to check SSO tokens.

anita: done: removed role binding at 2026-03-20T16:12:00Z. Added audit note: "INC-12345 - breakglass delegation for Okta outage".

ted: Filing follow-up ticket for root-cause and role rotation verification: TICKET-4567. Assigning to infra-sec.

maria: thanks all. We should add a short blurb to release notes about emergency hotfix + pinned version. I'll draft.

anita: FYI pinned the release in the release log: v1.3.2-hotfix -> abcdef12345

maria: closing thread. If anyone had to use breakglass, please update the postmortem checklist entry.
